intro: The small parts every page is built from: buttons, links, tags, statuses, fields, filters, tabs and dividers. Every state is shown.

button.title: Button
button.sizes: Sizes: small, medium, large, with an arrow that mirrors with the language.
button.note: Square corners, no shadow, and only a 200ms color change. One primary button per screen.

link.title: Link
link.inlineMiddle: on governance guides, and read what was written about them in
link.navNote: The current page: a 2px accent underline, and ink text.
link.moreNote: It says where it goes and how much is there. The arrow mirrors with the language.

tag.title: Tag
tag.note: A tag is a hairline frame with no fill. Only "Coming soon" is in the accent, and "Draft" has a dashed frame. Tags aren't for statuses: statuses have their own component.

status.title: Status
status.note: Always a glyph and a word. Each status has its own glyph shape, so color never carries the meaning alone.

fields.title: Fields
fields.fullNamePlaceholder: As you'd like me to address you
fields.emailError: Write a full email address, like name@example.org
fields.subject: Subject
fields.facingValue: We're working on a new internal system, and need an independent view before it goes to the board.
fields.facingHint: Write it the way you'd explain it to a colleague. No formal wording needed.
fields.ltrNote: Email and phone read LTR, in Western digits, even in an Arabic form.

choice.title: Choice
choice.everyReply: Email me at every new reply
choice.dayBefore: Remind me a day before the meeting
choice.consentError: You can't send this before agreeing.

file.title: File upload
file.label: Attachments
file.dropHere: Drop the files to attach them
file.limits: up to 10 MB a file · 5 files a message
file.note: Types and limits show before anything is picked. A refused file says why, in words, and a broken upload can be retried.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search the blog
search.noResultsBefore: I haven't written about “{term}” yet. Try a shorter word, or

chips.title: Filters
chips.note: One choice per row: a square and a count. The chosen chip has a light wash and a filled square, not color alone. Rows wrap on phones.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.note: Single choice: a 2px underline. In the dashboard, each language is a tab, and a tab with an error carries a mark.
tabs.titleError: Write the English title, or leave both empty.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.note: Previous and next with an arrow that mirrors with the language, and the current page with an accent underline. On phones: "Page 5 of 12".

divider.title: Divider
divider.heavy: Heavy rule (2, rule): opens a section, a record or the header. It never closes anything.
divider.hair: Hairline (1, line): between rows inside a record.
divider.dated: Dated rule: separates conversations and timelines by day or month.

skeleton.title: Loading skeleton
skeleton.note: A skeleton takes the exact shape of what will appear, in surface. A slow pulse that stops with "reduce motion".
